Name: Cats of Final Fantasy - Fat Cat
Author: chlpper
Description:
Welcome to my latest modding project: Cats of Final Fantasy!
I started getting back into making mods again and I thought the Fat Cat from FFXIV would be the perfect start.
I was hoping to create retextures of other cat minions from FFXIV so, if you'd like to see a specific one in Stardew, please let me know in the comments and I may make it! :)

Join my Discord to follow my mod updates: [url=https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8]https://discord.gg/jkgbQStGX8[/url]
